body:
Brings a riddle and his missing wife’s belongings to the adventurers’ investigation.

Recorded role and choices

In October 2024, Ransnap asks the company to find his wife, saying a riddle was left behind. He takes the adventurers toward their home and retrieves a hairbrush when they ask for something carrying her scent. The selected record establishes his appeal and practical help, without completing the search or inventing the missing woman’s fate.
